title: Report-control write followed by information-report style frame
purpose: Cover report-related server logic by pairing an oversized but moderate visible-string style write analogue for a report identifier with a follow-on information-report-like frame, supporting mutation toward report serialization and visible-string ownership edge cases related to CVE-2026-18582.
expected_behavior: The target may accept or reject the write analogue, then parse the report-like follow-up if used in a replay, proxy, or bidirectional harness. Mutations of the visible-string size, object-name length, and report payload structure can explore stack or heap ownership assumptions in report-related code paths.
constraints_preserved: tpkt total lengths are consistent per message
covers reporting path distinct from dataset creation and discovery
uses moderate string size instead of exact historical oversized payload
issue_safety_notes: Avoids the exact historical overlong RptID write size and object path while preserving a safe analogue of report-control visible-string stress.
